scenario.topic: Choose the training plan for the amateur relay marathon

options.name: Balanced 12-Week Endurance and Speed Plan
options.upside: Offers a mix of endurance and speed workouts with moderate weekly time commitment.
options.concern: May be challenging for participants new to structured training schedules.

options.name: Intensive 8-Week Speed-Focused Plan
options.upside: Shorter duration with emphasis on speed development and strength training.
options.concern: Higher weekly time demand could be difficult for participants with limited availability.

options.name: Flexible 14-Week Low-Intensity Plan
options.upside: Longer plan with lower weekly hours and flexible scheduling options.
options.concern: Lower intensity may not sufficiently prepare participants aiming to improve speed.

options.name: Moderate 10-Week Mixed Training Plan
options.upside: Combines endurance, speed, and strength training with group run opportunities.
options.concern: Group runs may limit flexibility for participants with varying schedules.

shared_context: A group of seven amateur runners needs to select a training plan for an upcoming relay marathon. Each plan varies in duration, weekly training hours, and focus areas to accommodate different fitness levels and schedules.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a part-time graphic designer who enjoys running for relaxation and health.
personas.private_goal: To complete the marathon without risking burnout or injury.

A.reason_for: Balanced focus on endurance and speed fits her moderate commitment level.
A.reason_against: May be challenging to keep up with the structured schedule.

B.reason_against: High weekly hours and intensity may cause burnout.

C.reason_for: Flexible scheduling and lower intensity suit her need to avoid injury.

D.reason_for: Mix of training types is good for overall fitness.
D.reason_against: Group runs may reduce schedule flexibility.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a busy software engineer aiming to improve his speed and endurance.
personas.private_goal: To maximize speed gains within a manageable weekly time commitment.

A.reason_for: Good balance of endurance and speed with moderate weekly hours.

B.reason_for: Strong focus on speed and strength.
B.reason_against: High weekly hours may be difficult to sustain.

C.reason_against: Low intensity won’t meet his speed improvement goals.

D.reason_for: Mixed training and group runs could boost motivation.
D.reason_against: Group runs may conflict with his unpredictable hours.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a fitness enthusiast who enjoys detailed training plans and group activities.
personas.private_goal: To improve both speed and endurance efficiently before the marathon.

A.reason_for: Balanced plan with endurance and speed suits her goals.

B.reason_for: Intensive speed and strength training align with her ambitions.
B.reason_against: High weekly hours might be tiring.

C.reason_for: Flexible and low intensity is easy to manage.
C.reason_against: Too low intensity for her improvement goals.

D.reason_for: Group runs and mixed focus are appealing.
D.reason_against: Slightly less focus on speed than preferred.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a recreational runner who values social motivation and balanced training.
personas.private_goal: To enjoy training with others while improving overall fitness.

A.reason_for: Balanced endurance and speed with moderate hours.

B.reason_against: Too intense and time-consuming for his schedule.

C.reason_for: Flexible and low intensity fits some days.
C.reason_against: Lacks group runs and social aspect.

D.reason_for: Includes group runs and mixed training, matching his social and fitness goals.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a competitive amateur runner focused on maximizing speed gains quickly.
personas.private_goal: To improve speed and strength in a short timeframe before the marathon.

A.reason_for: Balanced approach including speed is good.

B.reason_for: Short, intensive plan focused on speed and strength fits her goals.

C.reason_against: Low intensity won’t meet her speed goals.

D.reason_against: Less focused on speed than plan B.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a part-time student balancing studies and running ambitions.
personas.private_goal: To improve speed and strength without compromising study time.

A.reason_for: Balanced plan with moderate hours is doable.
A.reason_against: Longer duration might conflict with study schedule.

B.reason_for: Short and intensive plan fits his limited available weeks.

C.reason_against: Low intensity may not improve speed enough.

D.reason_against: Group runs may interfere with study time.

personas.name: Tia
personas.background: Tia is a casual runner looking for a manageable plan that fits her lifestyle.
personas.private_goal: To steadily build endurance without overwhelming time commitments.

A.reason_for: Balanced approach is appealing for steady progress.
A.reason_against: May be slightly demanding on time.

B.reason_against: High weekly hours and intensity are too much.

C.reason_for: Flexible and low intensity fits her lifestyle and time constraints.

D.reason_for: Group runs and mixed training are somewhat interesting.
